title: Deeper/broader peer-matrix drift and optional consumer harness security boundary
mode: primary-source repository README and advisory review
scope: Reconcile the current ACadRust AC1009 DWG documentation against the earlier mutable snapshot
Assess operational safety of the existing optional OpenCADStudio consumer qualification route
Separate peer evidence status and application control-plane risk from libdxfrw format and geometry evidence

method.kind: Read-only primary-source web research plus local plan inspection
method.limitations: Both GitHub sources are mutable. The current README corrects a prior documentation snapshot but does not bind behavior to a pinned ACadRust package runtime. The OpenCADStudio advisory is scoped to the disclosed application-control modes and versions; no binary or parser path was exercised.

sources.revision: mutable main README reviewed 2026-10-17; quickstart names package 0.6.4
sources.observed: The current detailed version table lists AC1009/R12 DWG as R/W, followed by an explicit note that AC1009 DWG fidelity is incomplete. This supersedes the earlier plan snapshot of a table cell marked unavailable, but does not establish runtime behavior or completeness for a pinned artifact.

The advisory lists desktop builds <=2026.39.0 as affected when --http or --serve is enabled and 2026.40 as patched. It describes unauthenticated loopback REST access with wildcard CORS and open/command/save operations. It states ordinary GUI launch does not open this port and describes stdio MCP as using a token-protected GUI bridge.
The README documents one-shot --export and separate --serve/--mcp automation modes. These options identify possible harness routes, not format qualification.
OpenCADStudio is already classified in the ACadRust codec lineage as an optional application/consumer route, not an independent parser vote or automatic B-rep semantic oracle.

assessment.acadrustDisposition: ADVERTISED_R/W / FIDELITY_INCOMPLETE / NOT_RUN; keep AC1009 DWG peer evidence NOT_ESTABLISHED until a pinned artifact and exact operation are exercised. Do not change libdxfrw's support status.
assessment.harnessSecurityDisposition: For optional OpenCADStudio qualification, pin exact release/artifact and platform. Prefer ordinary GUI or one-shot offline CLI. Never start --http or --serve on a release at or below 2026.39.0; the advisory lists 2026.40 as patched. Do not introduce MCP/network-service setup into the plan.
assessment.findingClassification: Documentation evidence-status correction plus optional test-harness security/readiness note only; not a libdxfrw parser, writer, format, or geometry defect.
assessment.routeLineage: OpenCADStudio remains in the ACadRust codec lineage; its application/kernel stages do not create an independent file-format parser vote.
assessment.nonPromotion: Neither an advertised version-table cell nor a safe harness, app launch, parse, audit, or self-reopen promotes DWG/DXF support, owner closure, or ACIS semantic claims.
